root_cause_and_implementation: Before this work, EodPublicationRepository::buildManifestByPublicationId() -- the repository's one version-aware publication-manifest reader, already explicit-publication_id-scoped with no current/latest fallback -- did not select or expose any of the four V2 columns on md_publication_lineage_bindings (bound_input_schema_version, bound_input_context_json, bound_input_context_hash, bound_input_capture_manifest_json) at all; every reader surface that consumes it (evidence export, and by extension anything built on the manifest) was therefore blind to whether a publication had a V2 bound context, let alone whether that context was still valid. PublicationInputBindingService::verifyBeforeSeal's existing content-verification body (lineage presence, config_snapshot_id consistency, digest self-consistency via hash_equals, bundle structural readability, component_manifest.status trust, per-component payload_hash and source_run_id provenance against resolveSeedRunId) was extracted verbatim -- same exception messages, same order, zero behavioural change -- into a new private verifyBoundContext($run, $lineage): array, confirmed byte-identical in behaviour by re-running all 9 pre-existing Seal tests unmodified and green. verifyBeforeSeal itself now just performs its own Seal-specific preconditions (replay_verify rejection, publication existence, ownership, trade_date) then delegates to verifyBoundContext. A new public method, PublicationInputBindingService::readBoundContext($publicationId): array, resolves the publication and its owning run itself (no external $run parameter, since Reader classifies an already-sealed publication's own recorded state rather than comparing it to some other currently-executing run), and returns one of three classifications built entirely from contract vocabulary: 'V1_LEGACY_NO_V2_BOUND_CONTEXT' (available=false, reason=null) when the lineage row has no V2 columns populated at all; 'BLOCKED' (available=false, reason=<the exact verifyBoundContext exception message>) when a V2 bound context exists but fails any verification clause -- and in this case the components/scope/component_manifest keys are deliberately omitted from the return value entirely, so a BLOCKED classification can never be mistaken for verified content by a careless caller; or 'VERIFIED' (available=true) with the schema_version, bound_input_context_hash and the decoded scope/components/component_manifest, when every check passes. readBoundContext never writes anything (proven directly, P133) and never calls bind(). EodPublicationRepository::buildManifestByPublicationId() now sets $manifest['bound_input_context'] = app(PublicationInputBindingService::class)->readBoundContext(...) before casting to object -- the exact same app()-resolution idiom sealCandidatePublication already uses for verifyBeforeSeal. MarketDataEvidenceExportService::buildRunSummary() -- which already had an established, explicitly-commented pattern of reading every V2-derived field straight off the manifest array rather than computing anything itself ('Nothing is computed here... a run with no resolved publication exports them as null') -- gained four fields (bound_input_context_schema_version/status/available/hash) following that identical pattern, verified to read through the mocked-manifest fixture unchanged (P134). publicationManifestContext() (the private V1-manifest-hash helper used by assertPublicationManifestHashValid) was deliberately left untouched: it serves a narrower, unrelated V1 manifest-hash purpose, and readBoundContext() runs its own independent queries rather than depending on that helper's select list, so extending it was unnecessary and would have been added surface area against an already-proven V1 code path. resolveExplicitFixturePublication/resolvePublicationForEvidenceAudit (ReplayVerificationService's 'explicit historical replay resolution') and MarketDataReadProductRepository ('read-product repository') were read and audited, not modified: both already resolve by explicit run_id/publication_id/trade_date selector with no current/latest substitution (resolvePublicationForEvidenceAudit throws EVIDENCE_SELECTOR_MISSING rather than defaulting, and MarketDataReadProductRepository::rowsForReadablePublication takes an already-resolved $publication object as a parameter rather than looking one up itself) -- both already satisfy the contract's 'does not consult current/latest as fallback' clause and needed no change. ReplayVerificationService::actualBoundInputContext, the PUBLICATION_EXACT/AS_KNOWN comparison and MATCH/MISMATCH decision logic, and ReplayResult persistence were deliberately not touched: the C1 contract Sec6 step 5 (Admission) explicitly names ReplayVerificationService as sharing 'a validator for both exact and as-known required inputs' and deciding BLOCKED/MATCH/MISMATCH, which is out of this work unit's scope by the user's explicit instruction not to start Admission.
